primary_SLO: Baseline-only model-specific TTFT and per-request average TPOT; joint attainment >=90%
long_window_seed_amendment: Declared before extension execution. Disjoint from the main confirmation seeds to prevent repeated arrival traces from becoming independent CI clusters.
long_window_full_population_amendment: Before extension execution, preserve all200 distinct W1 source prompts at every primary rate. Round larger counts to whole200-prompt cycles. When the initial PD_G1 ladder has no pass, test half its lowest rate but do not add an automatic quarter-rate point with a reduced prefix sample. This replaces the earlier reduced-N feasibility plan without changing the SLO or model.
colocated_feasibility_amendment: Declared after the first baseline point, before extension execution. Also include the largest passing DP_Mixed rate, or half its lowest attempted rate if none passes. Keep the SLO unchanged. This avoids mistaking an untested lower rate for zero colocated capacity.
new_run_order: Rotate arm order; cross physical pairs on confirmation
extension_order_amendment: Before extension execution, alternate order with floor(seed/1000) modulo remaining arm count. The main controller's seed modulo arm count does not alternate two-arm order after B closes because its seed offsets are even. Preserve that limitation in the main results.
longer_window_rule: If at least two GPU hours remain, target 360s arrival windows with 200 distinct W1 texts cycled under unique occurrence IDs. Use PD_G1's passing boundary and one midpoint or 1.5x ceiling refinement. If its initial ladder has no passing point, test half and one quarter of its lowest attempted rate without changing the SLO. Repeat with two independent seeds. Keep all rows.
capacity_drain_rule: Drain-inclusive completed rate must reach >=90% of realized trace arrival rate in addition to completed trace, >=90% joint attainment, and weak backlog check.
capacity_scope: Bounded tested-grid estimates unless queue stability and bracket coverage support a stronger claim. Do not turn short windows into proof of steady state.
CI_rule: Paired whole-start cluster bootstrap for same-rate goodput. Wilson request-attainment intervals remain separate. Neither is a selection-adjusted sustainable-capacity ratio interval.
novelty: GenericLayer LIVE is NOT_MEASURED. Logical-layer readiness can reproduce B's DAG. No loop-exclusive novelty GO.
correctness_stop: After any matched B/PD_G1 natural-output mismatch, stop accepting B performance and do not silently replace it with frozen-token replay.
